questions.prompt: Why does the tool_result block carry tool_use_id call_01?
options: The API needs it to bill the request
It names the tool to run
It pairs the result with the tool call it answers
It tells the model to stop
questions.explanation: The call id is the ticket number. It tells the model exactly which of its tool calls this output answers, even when there are several.

questions.prompt: The program sends the tool result but leaves out the assistant message with the tool call. What goes wrong?
options: The result answers a call that is not in the conversation, so the request is invalid
The model runs count_lines a second time by itself
The result is sent to the wrong model
questions.explanation: The model is stateless and sees only this request. A result must follow the call it answers, so the call must stay in the conversation.

questions.prompt: In which kind of message does the tool result go?
options: A separate HTTP request with no messages
questions.explanation: To the model, the result comes from outside the model, so it goes in a user message as a tool_result block.
